item.title: All Creative Work Is Derivative
item.description: Every creative work is built from earlier work; originality is a new arrangement of what already exists, not creation from nothing.

item.title: All Creative Work Is Derivative (Nina Paley)
item.description: Nina Paley’s short animation, made entirely from photographs of sculptures at the Metropolitan Museum of Art, arguing that all creative work builds on what came before.

item.title: Copyright Protects Expression, Not Ideas
item.description: Copyright covers the specific form in which an idea is expressed, never the idea itself; that line is what leaves room for the borrowing all culture runs on.

item.title: The Public Domain Is Raw Material for New Work
item.description: Once a work’s copyright expires, anyone can build on it without permission; long copyright terms shrink that pool and make some new work impossible.

item.title: From Zero to Creative Hero in Five Steps (Instagram Reel)
item.description: Five-step framework for creative growth from an Instagram reel; pinned here mainly as a reminder to read the two books on rhetoric it recommends.

item.title: Amateur
item.description: The enthusiast who pursues her work in the spirit of love.

item.title: Amateur Mindset
item.description: Embracing the beginner’s mind and incremental improvement over perfectionism.

item.title: Creativity is a Way of Operating - John Cleese
item.description: Creativity is not a talent, it is a way of operating.

item.title: Lone Genius Myth
item.description: The false narrative that great work emerges from isolated individuals with superhuman talents.

item.title: Process Documentation
item.description: Becoming a documentarian of your work to track progress and create shareable content.

item.title: Process is Messy
item.description: You have to make stuff. Share something small every day.

item.title: Scenius
item.description: An ecology of talent where great ideas emerge from collaborative creative communities.

item.title: Show Your Work! by Austin Kleon
item.description: 10 ways to share your creativity and get discovered - a guide to showing your work and building an audience.

item.title: Imperfection Is Beauty - Marilyn Monroe
item.description: Quote about embracing imperfection, madness, and being ridiculous over boring.
